messages.text: Hi, I asked for a refund for the ceramic vase last week and confirmed it, but nothing happened. Can you sort it out?

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"d10-o1","unit_ids":["d10-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer says they requested and confirmed a refund for the returned ceramic vase last week, but no refund has arrived. Please review the prior request/status."}

messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-fa92adae9edd4160", "status": "ineligible", "outcome": "needs_person", "amount_minor": null, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": ["refund-policy/v1/window"], "next_step": "This needs a person: hand off with request_handoff and tell the customer."}

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund timing window eligibility for returned item and what to do when refund proposal says needs person"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
